# UC-022 — View Finances & Payouts

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-022
- **Title:** View Finances & Payouts
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — Owner only (financial scope)
- **Trigger:** Vendor opens the Finance section of the seller dashboard
- **Priority:** P1
- **Goal:** Give the vendor transparent visibility of sales, escrow status, commission, refunds, and payout batches.
- **Preconditions:** Vendor authenticated with own store (BR-VND-07); KYC = APPROVED for payouts (BR-ESC-06).

## Main Scenario
1. Vendor opens Finance → client `GET /store/finance/overview` returns: available payable balance, escrow-held amount, pending payout, period sales (BR-FIN-04).
2. Vendor reviews line items: per-order revenue, commission = line subtotal after coupon × tier rate 5–20% (default 10%) computed at release (BR-ESC-03), refunds and reversals (BR-ESC-04).
3. Vendor opens the escrow list → each sub-order shows `DELIVERED` date, 7-day countdown (BR-ESC-01), and release conditions (no dispute, state not in return/dispute set, BR-ESC-02).
4. Vendor opens Payouts → shows batches executed 3–7 business days after release, minimum 1,000 YER with sub-threshold rollover (BR-ESC-05), bank details, and status.
5. Vendor downloads the monthly statement: sales, commission, refunds, payouts, adjustments (BR-FIN-04); dashboard charts derive from FR-018 reports.
6. All amounts render as integer YER with `ar-YE` formatting (BR-PAY-10, BR-PLT-05).

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — Store suspended (BR-VND-04):** Payouts held pending review; finance becomes read-only with a notice.
- **A2 — Below payout minimum:** Payable < 1,000 YER → amount rolls over to the next batch (BR-ESC-05); status shows "rollover".
- **A3 — Refund liability:** Escrow insufficient at refund → refund draws vendor payable (BR-ESC-07); the deduction appears with the linked order.

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — Reconciliation mismatch:** Daily reconciliation flags imbalance → vendor-facing numbers stay snapshot-consistent; finance alerted (BR-ESC-08, BR-FIN-03); vendor sees "under review" marker on affected items.
- **E2 — Cross-store request:** Vendor queries another store's finances → denied at service layer (BR-VND-07).
- **E3 — Report job delay:** Monthly statement not yet generated → last available statement downloadable; job retried (BR-PLT-02).

## Postconditions
- Read-only: no ledger, escrow, or payout change originates from viewing.
- Vendor understands exactly what will be paid and when (escrow/payout rules surfaced).

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-ESC-01, BR-ESC-02, BR-ESC-03, BR-ESC-04, BR-ESC-05, BR-ESC-06, BR-ESC-07, BR-ESC-08, BR-FIN-03, BR-FIN-04, BR-PAY-10, BR-VND-04, BR-VND-07, BR-PLT-05

## Related Requirements
- FR-014 (Escrow, Commission & Vendor Payouts), FR-018 (Analytics & Reporting)

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** Owner role; own `store_id` only (BR-VND-07); no access to customer wallet ledgers (DOC-OVR-007).
- **Data involved:** Payable balances, escrow rows, commission records, payout batches, statements.
- **External dependencies:** Ledger/escrow services (B07); reconciliation jobs (BR-FIN-03); report generator (B11).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC022-01:** Given a delivered sub-order, when 7 days have not elapsed, then release is shown as pending (BR-ESC-01/02).
- **AC-UC022-02:** Given payable 700 YER, when the batch runs, then it rolls over (min 1,000 YER, BR-ESC-05).
- **AC-UC022-03:** Given vendor X, when requesting finances of store Y, then access is denied (BR-VND-07).
